summary: SPE-4794 companion C-2+C-1 on desk_receipt_approve, hard-fixed against Greptile 3/5: fail closed when the tip can't be resolved instead of silently disabling the C-2 guard, gate the stamped candidate with check_receipt strict=True (not False), and this receipt's own claims now cite evidence_command_index instead of free-text evidence. Does not edit programming-desk #40.

commands.cmd: grep -n "await repo.receipt_check(candidate, candidate.get(\"bot\") or \"\", True, args[\"receipt_path\"])" services/desk-gateway/src/desk_gateway/tools/quality.py

claims.claim: quality.py parses as valid Python 3 after the tip-check + strict=True hard-fix
receipt_approve gates the stamped candidate through check_receipt with strict=True, not strict=False

receipt_approve's first-stamp path (C-1) stamps approved_by/approved_at and pushes when the receipt's claims cite evidence_command_index and G-2/G-3/G-5-6 pass in strict mode, against a real bare git remote
check_receipt (G-2) refuses a claim that cites free-text 'evidence' instead of evidence_command_index with gate_failed, and the branch tip is left unmoved
_commit_file (C-2 TOCTOU) refuses the push with stale_read and leaves the remote branch tip unchanged when it moved after the receipt was read
the full desk-gateway test suite (102 tests, including these 3 new regressions) passes with no other regressions

unverified: no live desk_receipt_approve call against the deployed gateway process; all coverage here is direct unit calls to quality.receipt_approve/_commit_file against a local bare git remote built in tmp_path

the read_sha is None fail-closed guard (added alongside the strict-True fix) has no dedicated regression test: Repo.resolve_ref falls back to HEAD rather than surfacing None for an unresolvable ref, so triggering the None path without also changing resolve_ref is out of scope for this hard-fix
